about: Touhou Luna Nights is a Metroidvania title with a heavy emphasis on exploration and action.
Remilia Scarlet, head vampire of the Scarlet Devil Mansion sends her maid Sakuya Izayoi with no warning to a world much like Gensokyo, but not quite.
A world full of strange places, filled with strange youkai and her time manipulation sealed.
What could Remilia’s end game be...?
- A time stop system using the character's Ability and Gimmick maps that utilize it
- Experience the "graze" system from Touhou Project in a 2D game, providing tense enemy encounters
- Stunning pixel graphics that bring out the appeal of the world of Touhou
summary: Touhou Luna Nights is a Metroidvania title with a heavy emphasis on exploration and action.
